review_notes: Segment 0: Several Sanskrit/Vedanta technical phrases (from 'यथा लोके...' onwards) retained as in the raw transcript. Sandhi and compound splits (e.g., 'परिच्छिन्नोदके', 'सम्प्लुतोदकस्थानीयम्', 'वेदोक्तेषु कर्मसु...' constructions) may require a subject-matter reviewer to confirm classical-sanskrit forms and intended punctuation.
Segment 0: The transcript contains many purposeful repetitions (speaker emphasis). These have been preserved per instructions.

Segment 2: वाक्यांश 'त्रैगुण्य विषया वेदाः। निस्त्रैगुण्यो भव।' संस्कृत उद्धरण/उपरोक्त वाक्यांश के रूप में आया है; मूल श्लोक का सही संस्करण स्पष्ट नहीं है — मानक श्लोक-संशोधन के लिए मानव समीक्षानुशंसा।
Segment 2: वाक्यांश 'माया-वया' सम्भवतः ASR त्रुटि है; मूल आशय अस्पष्ट है। हिन्दी वाक्य-संदर्भ के अनुसार यह किसी अन्य शब्द का विकृत रूप हो सकता है — मानव समीक्षा सुझायी जाती है।
Segment 2: वाक्यांश 'हेतु-वेतु' असामान्य लगता है; सम्भवतः ASR त्रुटि (उदा. 'हेतु-वस्तु' या 'हेतु-वस्तु को') — यदि शुद्धिकरण आवश्यक है तो वक्ता से पुष्टि करें।

Segment 6: Sanskritized expressions like 'सर्वतः सम्प्लुतोदके सति', 'तावान् ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः', 'त्रैगुण्य विषया वेदाः' preserved as in raw text; यदि आवश्यक हो तो शुद्ध शब्दरूप (विराम/विसर्ग/समास) के लिए भाषा-विशेशज्ञ की समीक्षा लाभदायक हो सकती है।

Segment 6: 'ब्राह्मणस्य विजानतः' और 'निस्त्रैगुण्य भाव' जैसे पदों में सम्भव वैकल्पिक संस्कृत-रूप (उदा. 'विज्ञानतः' / 'निस्त्रैगुण्योभाव') के संदर्भ में संदेह है — पाठक/समीक्षक द्वारा सत्यापन उपयोगी होगा।
Segment 6: अंग्रेज़ी कोड-स्विचिंग वाक्यांशों में स्पेलिंग/ट्रांसलिटरेशन में मध्यम-सम्मति पर सुधार किए गए; यदि वक्ता की ठोस लेख्य अभिव्यक्ति चाहिए तो ऑडियो संदर्भ से मिलान करना उपयोगी रहेगा।

Segment 7: Several Sanskrit phrases and compound Sanskrit-Hindi renderings (e.g., 'यावान अर्थ उदपाने', 'सम्प्लुतोदके सति', 'विज्ञानफलं सर्वतः संप्लुतोदकस्थानीयं') were left as in the raw transcript because their exact canonical forms are uncertain from ASR. Recommend human review for precise Sanskrit transliteration/standardization if required.

Segment 7: The speaker uses colloquial usages and discourse fillers (e.g., 'मेरे को', repeated 'यह/ये', interjections like 'नारायण') deliberately; these were mostly preserved to keep the speaker's style and meaning intact.

Segment 9: The phrase 'कर्तृत्वपूर्वक की हुई' was left as in the transcript; speaker's exact Sanskrit/Hindi formulation is somewhat unclear — please verify against audio if precise technical wording is important.

Segment 9: Several Sanskrit compounds were corrected for spacing/orthography (e.g., 'कर्मण्येवाधिकारः', 'प्रकृति-बद्ध'). If strict verbatim Sanskrit transcription is required, verify these against the original utterance.
Segment 10: The correction 'बद' → 'बुराई' is medium-confidence: ASR likely misrecognized the word, but the intended original could vary; please verify against the audio or original transcript.

Segment 10: The Sanskrit phrasing at the end was lightly normalized (commas removed). If a canonical or exact Sanskrit formulation is required, please verify the intended wording from the speaker/audio.

Segment 11: The phrase 'अधिकार शब्द दीप देहली न्याय से यहाँ भी जुड़ेगा' appears garbled or misrecognized. I preserved the original wording because the intended terms are unclear; please verify and correct if needed.
Segment 12: Standardized a clearly quoted Bhagavadgītā verse to its canonical form (Gītā 2.47) based on context and glossary hints.
Segment 12: Other code-switched and colloquial phrases were preserved; uncertain or ambiguous fragments were left as in the raw transcript to avoid altering meaning.

Segment 13: Speaker uses multiple variants of the same Sanskrit phrase. I standardized two occurrences to the common sandhi form 'मा ते सङ्गोऽस्तु अकर्मणि' while preserving the mid-occurrence 'अकर्मणि सङ्गः मा अस्तु' as spoken.
Segment 13: No other high-confidence ASR errors detected; English/Hindi code-switching and informal phrasing preserved.
